note: あとで is only the reading of 後で: a homophone window across the particle does not take the listed noun.
Guard: もんか is spelled so in the dictionary, so もん stays out.
や|だ joined: the spoken いやだ is listed as やだ.
すん|ませ|ん joined, as すみません is.
かまわ|ない joined: 構わない is its own entry.
The obligation unit is what follows the conditional; 行かなきゃ stays the verb's chain.

sentence: そういえば昨日会った
note: そう|いえ|ば at a clause start is the connective, not そう + いう.
よう|こそ joined: the greeting, not よい.
それで|は opening a clause is the connective それでは, not それで.
